title: Iron
body:
Description

Iron ore can spawn in Lightslate, Beigeslate, Darkslate, and Marble.

The raw form of Iron takes on a gray color, so it can be mistaken for Tin.

Putting Iron in a refiner raises the sell price to $34 per stud. Putting that refined Iron through a forge further increases the price to $40 per stud.

Like any other material in the game, you can use refined and forged Iron to complete schematics.
